entries.name: tax-starter-pinned
entries.claim: The starter rates are exactly the reviewed Canadian table.

kills.name: the starter template is the pinned Canadian table
kills.expected: the starter rates differ from the pinned table

entries.name: tax-starter-never-overwrites
entries.claim: Re-applying the starter changes nothing and never touches a code the tenant has.
entries.original:
CONTINUE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT FROM platform.tax_catalog_codes c
      WHERE (c.tenant_id, c.environment_id, c.code) = (t, e, starter.code));

kills.name: re-applying the starter changes nothing and never overwrites an edited code
kills.expected: tax\.versionNotAfterLatest

entries.name: tax-read-codes-at-date
entries.claim: The codes offered on a day carry the version in force that day.
entries.original: AND w.effective_from <= at ORDER BY

kills.name: the codes read on a day give the version in force that day
kills.expected: a later version answered for an earlier day

entries.name: tax-read-code-at-date
entries.claim: One code read on a day carries its version in force that day.
entries.original: AND v.effective_from <= at

kills.name: one code read on a day gives its version in force
kills.expected: a later version answered one code for an earlier day

entries.name: tax-read-codes-inactive
entries.claim: An inactive code is never offered.
entries.original: WHERE c.tenant_id = t AND c.environment_id = e AND c.active
entries.replacement: WHERE c.tenant_id = t AND c.environment_id = e

kills.name: an inactive code is not offered
kills.expected: an inactive code was offered

entries.name: tax-read-code-inactive
entries.claim: An inactive code refuses an exact read.
entries.original: IF NOT held.active THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax.codeInactive'; END IF;

kills.name: an inactive code refuses an exact read
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: an inactive code answered an exact read

entries.name: tax-read-codes-tenant
entries.claim: Another tenant reads none of these codes.
entries.original: WHERE c.tenant_id = t AND c.environment_id = e AND c.active

kills.name: another tenant reads none of these codes
kills.expected: another tenant read this tenant's codes

entries.name: tax-read-registrations-tenant
entries.claim: Another tenant reads none of these registrations.
entries.original:
WHERE g.tenant_id = north_star_internal.trusted_tenant_id() AND g.environment_id = north_star_internal.trusted_environment_id()
      AND g.company_id = company

kills.name: another tenant reads none of these registrations
kills.expected: another tenant read this tenant's registrations

entries.name: tax-version-strictly-increasing
entries.claim: A version must start after the latest version of its code.
entries.original: IF latest IS NOT NULL AND start_day <= latest THEN
entries.replacement: IF false AND latest IS NOT NULL AND start_day <= latest THEN

kills.name: a version on or before the latest version day is refused
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: an earlier version was appended

entries.name: tax-version-one-per-day
entries.claim: Storage holds at most one version of a code per day.
entries.original: CONSTRAINT tax_catalog_versions_one_per_day UNIQUE (tenant_id, environment_id, code_id, effective_from),

kills.name: storage refuses two versions of one code on one day
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: two versions of one code were stored on one day

entries.name: tax-version-append-only
entries.claim: A stored version never changes.
entries.original: CREATE TRIGGER tax_catalog_versions_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE

kills.name: storage refuses changing a version, its components, a component or a receipt
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: the owner updated platform\.tax_catalog_versions

entries.name: tax-rate-range
entries.claim: A component rate is between 0 and 100 percent.
entries.original: CHECK (rate_percent >= 0 AND rate_percent <= 100)

kills.name: storage refuses a rate outside 0 to 100
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: a rate above 100 percent was stored

entries.name: tax-recoverable-range
entries.claim: A recoverable share is between 0 and 100 percent.
entries.original: CHECK (recoverable_percent >= 0 AND recoverable_percent <= 100)

kills.name: storage refuses a recoverable share outside 0 to 100
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: a recoverable share above 100 percent was stored

entries.name: tax-registration-no-overlap
entries.claim: A company has at most one registration in force per jurisdiction on any day.
entries.original:
CONSTRAINT tax_registrations_no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (
    tenant_id WITH =, environment_id WITH =, company_id WITH =, jurisdiction_id WITH =,
    daterange(effective_from, effective_to, '[)') WITH &&),

kills.name: storage refuses overlapping registrations of one company in one jurisdiction
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: overlapping registrations were stored

entries.name: tax-registration-range
entries.claim: A registration ends after it starts.
entries.original: CONSTRAINT tax_registrations_range CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from),

kills.name: storage refuses a registration that ends on or before it starts
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: an empty registration range was stored

entries.name: tax-no-table-grant
entries.claim: No non-owner role holds a privilege on a tax table.
entries.original: EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON platform.%I FROM PUBLIC, north_star_runtime', tab);
entries.replacement: EXECUTE format('GRANT SELECT ON platform.%I TO north_star_runtime', tab);

kills.name: no non-owner role holds a tax table privilege and tenant tables force RLS
kills.expected: a non-owner role holds a tax table privilege

entries.name: tax-forced-rls
entries.claim: Every tenant tax table forces row-level security.
entries.original: EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE platform.%I FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', tab);
entries.replacement: EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE platform.%I NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', tab);

kills.name: no non-owner role holds a tax table privilege and tenant tables force RLS
kills.expected: a tenant tax table does not force row-level security

entries.name: tax-function-execute
entries.claim: Only north_star_runtime executes the five platform functions; no one executes the setters.
entries.original: EXECUTE format('REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC', routine);
entries.replacement: EXECUTE format('COMMENT ON FUNCTION %s IS NULL', routine);

kills.name: only north_star_runtime executes the five platform functions and no one the rest
kills.expected: a tax function is executable beyond its grant

entries.name: tax-release-fence
entries.claim: A review is bound to the release AND fence it was reviewed under.
entries.original: WHERE (tenant_id, environment_id, release_id, fence) = (t, e, r.release_id, r.fence) FOR SHARE;
entries.replacement: WHERE (tenant_id, environment_id, release_id) = (t, e, r.release_id) FOR SHARE;

kills.name: a review does not survive a release switch and back
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: a review confirmed after the release switched away and back

entries.name: tax-review-single-use
entries.claim: A review is confirmed at most once.
entries.original: AND consumed_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE;

kills.name: a confirmed review cannot be confirmed again
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: a review was confirmed twice

entries.name: tax-review-digest
entries.claim: A confirm applies only the exact digest that was reviewed.
entries.original: IF NOT FOUND OR r.digest IS DISTINCT FROM reviewed_digest THEN

kills.name: a confirm with another digest is refused
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: a confirm with a different digest applied the review

entries.name: tax-review-principal
entries.claim: Only the reviewing principal confirms a review.
entries.original: WHERE (tenant_id, environment_id, review_id, principal_id) = (t, e, review, p);

kills.name: another principal cannot confirm a review
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: another principal confirmed the writer's review

AND effective_to IS NULL
      RETURNING registration_id INTO chosen;
